chunks: When they brought fleet-footed chargers in the evening to show him,

key_terms.الصَّافِنَاتُ: Fleet-footed horses, specifically those that lift their forelegs high when running

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the horses presented to Prophet Sulaiman in Surah Sad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights Prophet Sulaiman’s immediate responsiveness to divine call, where the 'evening' presentation signifies the urgency of his devotion. The sacrifice of the 'swift horses' is interpreted not merely as an act of gratitude but as a demonstration of subordinating worldly power and military strength to spiritual obedience, a trait highly valued in Imami theology.
